notes.title: Update: Bugfixes, Settings menu added
notes.notes:
Hi All,
A new build has been uploaded that hopefully fixes a lot of the problems that were occuring with achievements, and the game not running on some platforms. The game's libraries have all been upgraded to the latest versions, and should be talking to eachother nicely. The game has been tested on all platforms, and seems to be running fine, exiting correctly, unlocking achievements and showing the steam overlay.

Patch notes:
Some minor content updates, including 
- properly rendering links in a reply
- properly rendering hashtag links in Julius's messages

The "cyberpun" achievement should be activating consistantly when the player selects the "keep it going" dialogue option.

A "Settings" menu has been added to fulfill requests by some players, it allows you to toggle between full-screen and windowed, and change the zoom level

The Log out button has been moved to the top right, replacing the "estimated arrival date" which some players found confusing.

notes.title: Wot I Think: Killing Time At Lightspeed
notes.notes:
Something I’m very much looking forward to is seeing the visual novel increasingly mature away from creepy adolescent dating simulators toward more interesting topics. It’s already happening, of course, but it’s safe to say the genre has a “norm”. A lovely example of something utterly different is Killing Time At Lightspeed [official site], a science fiction tale of future technologies and future travel, told through the medium on social media. Here’s wot I think:

notes.title: Killing Time At Lightspeed s Enhanced Edition Out Now
notes.notes:
Killing Time at Lightspeed [official site] is a quirky interactive fiction-type adventure game that was created for last year’s sci-fi anthology-inspired Antholojam. It’s…it’s hard to explain. Ostensibly, it’s a game about travelling on a spaceship where your only means of interaction with home is via social media. But the further you travel from earth, the longer the delay is between your messages – to the point where refreshing your homepage skips years at a time. Holding a mirror to modern culture, then, the game often dives into some pretty dark and somber themes as you uncover snippets of life in uncertain times. “Just how much can you affect other people’s lives with your fleeting interactions through social media?” asks the game’s blurb.

The game’s Enhanced Edition has just landed on Steam if you’re keen to find out.

notes.title: Update: News article links should no longer restart the game.
notes.notes:
I've just published a patch that should fix the issue with links in news articles, as well as:
- some minor spelling fixes
- potential fix for the game not closing correctly on mac
- fixed two achievements that weren't being triggered correctly
- fixed some messages that weren't nested correctly

There was a few hours in-between patches tonight where the mac version wouldn't load correctly. It seems to be running fine again now.

notes.title: Bug: Please don't click links inside news articles for now.
notes.notes:
There is a small but critical bug in Killing Time at Lightspeed, please don't click the links inside news articles. It may restart the game.

Currently figuring out if it's ALL links, or a specific one (all users who've reported this bug have said it happened on the same article).

I'm really sorry if you hit this bug. Should be patched in the morning!
